metaTitle: Apartment GDV & Viability Calculator | Thistle Architecture
metaDescription: Free apartment GDV and viability calculator for conversion schemes. Enter purchase price, area, units, and sale prices; see projected margin and a quick verdict on whether the deal stacks up.

hero.label: Apartment GDV Calculator
hero.heading: Do The Numbers Stack Up?
hero.description: A quick back-of-envelope viability check. Five inputs, live outputs, sensible defaults to start.

outcomes.label: Marginal
outcomes.body: Margin under 10%. The deal is fragile, since small cost overruns or sale-price misses could wipe it. A feasibility runs comparables and a real risk register so you know what you are actually buying.

outcomes.label: Viable
outcomes.body: Margin between 10 and 25%. The deal looks workable on paper. A feasibility confirms the GDV against local comparables and pressure-tests the build cost.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.body: Margin over 25%. The numbers look strong, which usually means either you have a real edge, or one of your inputs is optimistic. A feasibility tells you which.

disclaimer: Indicative numbers only. A real feasibility models comparables, voids, and risk.

closing.heading: The Tool Is A Hint.
closing.body: Get a real, architect-led feasibility on the building in five days. Fixed fee, clear Go or No-Go.
